objective: Build a basis-separated PIT canonical fundamental feature panel from the Phase 2A.3 validated compact documents and audit cross-quarter continuity without introducing derived growth signals yet.
row_grain: symbol + quarter_end + reporting_basis + latest PIT-qualified filing event
rules: Keep CONSOLIDATED and STANDALONE as separate histories.
Include all 2,181 expected latest-event groups, including the 10 terminal official archive gaps.
Preserve canonical feature status, selected concept and normalized numeric value.
Preserve source event id, availability timestamp and source representation provenance.
Do not calculate QoQ/YoY growth, ratios, scores, labels or prediction features in Phase 2A.4.
Continuity audit is descriptive: report observed quarter presence/gaps without inventing a regulatory cadence rule.
Any semantic hard failure in an existing compact document is a hard Phase 2A.4 failure.
hard_gates: Expected panel row count must equal 2,181.
Terminal archive gap row count must equal 10.
Semantic hard failure count must equal 0.
